target_customer: Independent and small chain restaurants, especially those that take phone and catering orders
problem: Restaurants lose revenue when busy staff miss phone orders; StrideQ answers calls automatically and takes orders, later adding catering inquiry tools.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription, no commission and no contracts per company site

founders.name: Shreyansh Gandhi
founders.background_notes: YC page: led catalog data science at WalmartLabs, early AWS EC2 engineer, 6 patents.

founders.name: Sreehari Pulikkal Sivadasan
education: Amrita University India, MS and BS Computer Science
founders.background_notes: YC page: senior engineer on large scale distributed systems.

competitors.name: Kea
competitors.what: Voice AI that answers restaurant phone orders

competitors.name: ConverseNow
competitors.what: AI voice ordering across phone, drive thru and kiosk
competitors.funding_then: 3.25M seed in 2020-05, 15M Series A reported 2021-07 (within batch)

technical_complexity.rationale: Speech recognition and order parsing over phone calls with menu integration, using third party speech tools, was achievable for a two person team but accuracy was hard.

defensibility.rationale: Phone ordering voice agents were easy to copy as speech models improved; stickiness would come from POS and menu integration, which was thin at founding.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Better funded voice AI rivals existed before the batch, and Slang.ai raised 20M in June 2023; StrideQ stayed small.

market_need_then: The YC description cites that 33 percent of restaurant customers still preferred phone ordering while staff were stretched, especially during COVID era staff shortages.

identity.voice_and_tone: Plain benefit claims such as no missed calls, no missed orders

rebrands.why: Not stated by sources found; YC page says formerly SliceQ.

brand_strength.rationale: No press or community about the brand found; a rename left some aggregators listing both names.

pivots.to: Phone ordering plus AI catering bot and catering management tools
pivots.why: Company site now emphasizes catering; reason and date not stated.

outcome_analysis: StrideQ remains active as a very small team with no public priced round, only about 170K in aggregator listed funding including YC. It entered a space where Kea and ConverseNow were already funded, and the product is easy to copy as voice AI improves, so it stalled at an early stage rather than clearly failing.
notes: Funding: CB Insights (aggregator only) reports 170K over 2 rounds including a 40K convertible note dated 2021-10-06 and YC as investor; unverified, not recorded as rounds. Founders and education come from the YC page. Rename SliceQ to StrideQ is undated. No shutdown, acquisition or layoffs found. Name origin not found.
